text: I feel intrigued by the deliberate design of this space—the glass walls framing a bright, purposeful interior, the presence of technology and bold print inviting me to contemplate innovation. The "R+D" exhibit hints at the restless curiosity that propels human understanding, and I sense a quiet urge within me to engage, to ask what more can be discovered here. The modernity and intentionality of everything makes me feel simultaneously like an observer and a participant in the ongoing dance of progress.
